news.label: GPT-Live-1.1 now available in the API
points: Voice conversation model in the API
details: It improves multilingual accents, recognition of letters and numbers, and instruction following.
Standby pauses the model after 5 to 60 seconds of silence while keeping the WebRTC connection alive. The regular rate is $0.05 per minute.
For always-listening voice AI devices, it speaks directly to balancing waiting cost with how fast a conversation resumes.

lines.say: Let's start with voice A I. Open A I has released GPT Live one point one in the A P I.
lines.show: Let's start with voice AI. OpenAI has released GPT-Live-1.1 in the API.

lines.say: There's also a new feature called Standby, which lowers the price while waiting. It's a nice fit for voice devices that stay on standby.
lines.show: A new Standby feature lowers the price while waiting, great for always-on voice devices.

link.title: GPT-Live-1.1 has arrived in the API
link.description: Hi developers,  GPT-Live-1.1 is now available in the API! You can use it to build voice agents that speak with more natural and consistent accents across languages, understand precise details like let

news.label: Genie 4 available through the API
points: Change weather and lighting by text
details: From text or reference images, it can create continuous worlds with sound.
You can explore with the keyboard and change objects and events using words.
Developers can build it into their own apps through the Interactions API.

lines.say: Next, news from Google. Genie four, which creates explorable virtual worlds, is now available in the Gemini A P I.
lines.show: Next, Google. Genie 4, which creates explorable virtual worlds, is now in the Gemini API.

lines.say: What's new is that you can change the weather and lighting with words, and build it into your own apps.
lines.show: You can change weather and lighting with words, and build it into your own apps.

link.title: Genie 4 is now available on the Gemini API.
link.description: Build interactive 720p worlds with Genie 4 on the Google Gemini API. Generate coherent environments with native audio and real-time controls. Get started.

news.label: Prusa Connect Local
points: Runs on a PC or Raspberry Pi
details: An account or internet connection isn't required, and your history and files stay on your own network.
You can set up the server on a PC, a Raspberry Pi, or a NAS.
It supports user-made extensions, and Klipper machines can connect through Moonraker using a sample driver.

lines.say: Now a three D printing story. Prusa has opened a public beta of Prusa Connect Local, which lets you manage printers without the cloud.
lines.show: A 3D printing story. Prusa has opened a public beta of Prusa Connect Local, no cloud needed.

lines.say: It can run on your own computer, and it works with Home Assistant too.
lines.show: It runs on your own computer and works with Home Assistant too.

link.title: Prusa Connect Local | Self-Hosted 3D Printer fleet management | Prusa
link.description: Run Prusa Connect Local on a Raspberry Pi, PC or NAS. One screen for all your printers, no cloud and no Prusa Account. Source code on GitHub.

news.label: ELEGOO four-head printer
points: Price and release date not announced
details: It switches whole heads when colors or materials change, aiming to cut the waste from purging.
The idea is to support prints that combine both kinds of material.

lines.say: More from Formnext. Elegoo has unveiled the Centauri X Ultra, which has four print heads.
lines.show: More from Formnext. ELEGOO has unveiled the Centauri X Ultra, with four print heads.

lines.say: Since it switches whole heads, it could cut down on wasted material. Price and release date haven't been announced.
lines.show: Switching whole heads could cut wasted material. Price and release date are not announced.

news.label: MOKO: 3D creation by AI and people
details: A generative AI makes a draft from your illustration, and people refine the shape and details.
It includes a review and up to two revisions, with delivery in formats such as STL, OBJ, FBX, and GLB.
Prices include tax. A standard rig for bipedal humanoids is an optional extra at 6,980 yen, tax included.
